title: Transcendence! At the Head of All Life

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I see,
I see! "Top speed over victory," is it?
Fascinating!
To think such a sharply unconventional
Umamusume existed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I told her about Calstone Light O,
that Umamusume—Agnes Tachyon—
laughed with sheer delight.
choice_data_list: What do you think? About that drea...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some might see it as warped.
After all, as an Umamusume,
aiming for victory is supposed to be...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What do I think? Why,
I find it exceedingly natural.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's instinct, pure instinct.
Wanting to best other Umamusume is instinct,
just as wishing to push speed to its utmost
limit is instinct.
Is that not entirely obvious?
choice_data_list: So you don't think it's warped at all?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. To begin with,
racing is nothing more than—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A miniature garden. Yes,
a sandbox.
Merely a boxed-in set of rules manufactured
for someone else's convenience.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why do starting gates exist?
Why are distances
1,200m or 2,400m instead of 10,000m or 20,000m?
And why...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are there curves on the track that Umamusume
are forced to turn?
Aren't all of those simply arbitrary
constraints of physical convenience?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Inherently,
there is no need for us to be bound by such
things. Indeed,
top speed is—the dream of science! Innovation!
The species' pure instinct!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Adapting to given conditions is admirable,
certainly.
However,
to brand instinct itself as wrong is utter
nonsense.
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon had a point.
Races were created by someone,
and there was no need to reject whatever
didn't fit into that mold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's desire was valid.
And yet...
choice_data_list: Should I really be supporting that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end,
it all boiled down to that.
Does that really mean
I should become her Trainer and support such
an unadulterated dream, or...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha,
what you choose to do is no concern of
mine.
However—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Logic. Yes,
what you are speaking of is merely logic.
No matter how much of that you pile up,
it is utterly meaningless.
choice_data_list: Logic?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Now, if you will excuse me.
I, too,
have matters that logic alone cannot
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon took her leave.
Much of what she said
was too complex to grasp. But even so,
one thought remained...
choice_data_list: I want to face her one more time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unless I faced Calstone Light O's running
and determined
what I truly wanted to do as a Trainer,
I couldn't move forward.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You want to see my running one more time?"
I do not mind, but...
Why go through the trouble of renting such
a massive track?
choice_data_list: I don't just want to watch. I have...
I don't just want to watch. I'd li...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A condition? Which would be—
choice_data_list: On a "straight line" with no curves!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The absolute simplest format to observe
running.
Not following the bends of a track,
but tearing down a long straightaway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt that unless I saw it under those
conditions,
I would never understand the true essence
of Calstone Light O's speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
Then on this straightaway,
I shall show you my limit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O takes off.
She accelerates in a seamless flow.
And—from here, it starts right here.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(I want to sprint. I want to run.
Faster than anything
and everything that exists in this world.
—Here I go!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohhh! Here and now,
beyond human! Beyond Umamusume!
Beyond every beast!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To the pinnacle of all living things!
Ooooooooohhhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I can still go faster! Faster yetttt!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O finally broke into a realm
never before
seen in a race. And then—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaghhhh!! This is—my current limit.
But someday,
I will reach beyond this light!!
choice_data_list: Aah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had finally reached the extreme limit.
It might not be the fastest of all life
yet. Even so,
watching Calstone Light O sprint at full
throttle—
choice_data_list: What... incredible running...
What... incredible running...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Logic. Yes,
what you are speaking of is merely logic.
No matter how much of that you pile up,
it is utterly meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood what Agnes Tachyon meant.
Yes, this wasn't about logic—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was hopelessly captivated and drawn to
Calstone Light O's running.
I knew that beyond a shadow of a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
*pant*,
*pant*...
I cannot run any further right now.
However—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I must reach it no matter what!
The other side of that wall of light!
Therefore—
choice_data_list: I get it, please let me help you!
I understand, let me help you!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—!? Trainer, are you certain?
From here on, what should we...
choice_data_list: We need "discipline and competition."
We need "discipline and competition."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Discipline and... competition?
Do you mean training and races?
choice_data_list: Exactly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Increasing speed through self-taught methods
had hit its ceiling here.
To push beyond,
a "plan" was necessary. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Discipline" grounded in sound analysis.
"Competition" against other Umamusume.
Without those,
the path forward would never open.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Competing in races.
I do not mind that,
but there is one problem...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Top speed over immediate victory.
If I stick to that conviction,
I may suffer consecutive defeats and fail
to stay in the Twinkle Series...
choice_data_list: I'll find a way to make it work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew her principles all too well.
If she dropped out of the
Twinkle Series,
she couldn't aim to be the fastest in history
either. So—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Refine her speed while making sure she still
won in the Twinkle Series.
That was my job as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
If I were to describe how I feel right
now—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want to hug you and dance while yelling
"Yahoo!"
choice_data_list: I-I'm glad, but... you really didn...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My apologies,
I am incapable of hiding things.
However—it is decided, then.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a deal.
Yup, it's a deal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes in three years.
choice_data_list: Wait, we haven't decided that far ...
Whoa, we haven't decided that far ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let your guard down for a second,
and Calstone Light O will bolt into
the distant future at the speed of light.
Together with her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I would chase it to the ends of the earth.
The ultimate dream no one had ever seen:
"Just how fast can an Umamusume run?"
